title: Golders Green Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent care, hazards, and supply points for Golders Green and Brent Cross.
content:
For life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 immediately.

1. Nearest 24-hour A&E Hospitals:
- Royal Free Hospital: Pond Street, Hampstead, London NW3 2QG. 24-hour A&E and Major Hospital. From Golders Green Station: ~2.5 miles southeast — take Northern line south to Belsize Park (~10 min walk northeast on Pond Street) or bus 268 direct along Finchley Road to Royal Free Hospital.
- Barnet Hospital: Wellhouse Lane, Barnet EN5 3DJ. 24-hour A&E. From Golders Green Station: ~7 miles north, or bus 107 from High Barnet.
- St Mary's Hospital: Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY. Major Trauma Centre. Accessible south via the A41.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres:
- Finchley Memorial Hospital Walk-in Centre: Granville Road, North Finchley N12 0JE. From Golders Green Station: ~3 miles north along Finchley Road / Regent's Park Road, or bus 460 / 102.
- Royal Free Urgent Treatment Centre: Pond Street NW3 2QG (co-located at the hospital site).

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- The River Brent flows north of Golders Green through Brent Park and near Brent Cross; areas adjacent to North Circular Road (A406) and the Brent reservoir corridor are susceptible to flash flooding and surface water pooling during heavy rainfall.

4. Supplies & Essentials:
- Pharmacies, bakeries, and large supermarkets along Golders Green Road and Finchley Road supply bottled water, over-the-counter drugs, and battery supplies.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
